turns.question: What was the week-over-week growth in leads for the week starting 14 September 2026?
turns.answer: Leads grew 20.7% week over week for the week starting 14 September 2026 (a share of 0.207, where 0.10 would be 10% more, compared with the prior week). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
